text:
ana: Heads-up — finalizing webinar plan for next week. Two priorities: (1) pick final abstracts (customer + engineering variants) and (2) run a blackbox simulation to stress test demo fallbacks.

mike: Sounds good. timeline?

ana: Planning timeline: abstracts due Wed EOD, content run Thu morning, blackbox Thu afternoon, dress Fri.

lisa: Can we add a short guest-onboarding test? i.e., invite an external panelist to join 10m early with no slides so we can validate permissions and mute controls.

marco: I can cover deep-tech + demo. will send a compact 40-word customer blurb + a 2-line engineering blurb.

jill: leaning yes for panel. my ask: keep my demo surface area minimal — show perf chart and fallback statement.

devon: Ops checklist for blackbox: well prepare three simulated incidents:
- routing to quantized model (simulate via feature flag)
- embedding service latencies (inject delay)
- GPU eviction fallback (force fallback to CPU node)
Ops will randomize order and notify producer only 1m before the run.

mike: For abstracts, let's standardize fields in the sheet: short title, customer blurb (<=40w), engineer blurb (<=2 lines), demo assets path. I'll add a template.

ana: link: https://tiny.redwood/webinar-abstracts (edit) — drop variants there. Keep one comment thread per speaker.

lisa: Rehearsal flow suggestion for blackbox run:
00:00 host intro (90s)
01:30 speaker 1 (10m)
11:30 demo 1 (5m)
16:30 panel discussion (8m)
24:30 ops surprise (5m)
29:30 recovery + fallback talking points (6m)
35:30 audience q (8m)
43:30 wrap (90s)

marco: can we have a 60s "fallback card" slide ready? simple text: what happened, what we did, next steps. ops to show it when fail occurs.

jill: agree. also please add a 90s fallback script stub to speaker notes (one sentence to open, one sentence to close).

devon: will create banner and standby slide. also prepping a short ops runbook with CLI rollback commands and feature-flag toggles. will share in the sheet.

mike: Quick demo infra checklist I'll add: env vars, ephemeral API key, rollback command, local replay script path. keep it minimal so guest can run if needed.

deploy-bot: Calendar invites created: 2026-04-07T16:00Z (content run), 2026-04-07T20:00Z (blackbox sim), 2026-04-08T22:00Z (dress). Reminders: 24h & 1h.

ana: One more thing  we want two abstract tones: marketing (benefits, outcomes) and engineering (benchmarks, configs). Please include both.

mike: I'll draft engineering tone examples in the sheet: include perf numbers, model name, quantization level.

lisa: For the guest-onboarding test, ops please ensure external guest JOIN flow works with our SSO and that we can mute/unmute from the producer panel.

devon: noted. I'll do a dry run with a contractor volunteer on Wed 10m before the content run.

marco: uploaded slide v0 and both abstract variants to the sheet.

jill: I'll decide by Wed AM and add my fallback script if I'm in.

ana: Action items: everyone — add final abstracts to the sheet by Wed EOD; mike — add demo infra checklist; devon — ops runbook + banners; deploy-bot — ensure invites & reminders.

mike: tagging the engineering copywriter to help sharpen the engineering blurb.

ana: Keep discussion in the sheet for copy edits. Use this thread for scheduling and failure scenarios only. Thanks! :clap:
